long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Samsun, Derindere began working in the family company while still at school and joined its management as a partner in 1979. His father, Ömer Derindere, had moved from food wholesaling into authorised vehicle sales and service. Özkan eventually became group chairman, helping shift the business from dealerships towards professional fleet management and operational leasing.

In 2007 he co-founded Derindere Motorlu Araçlar with engineer Önder Yol. The venture developed electric-vehicle control systems, powertrains and energy-storage technology in Turkey, adding an industrial innovation arm to the group’s automotive base. Derindere also chairs the family foundation, which supports scholarships and vocational education.

That convergence supports family transfer even though the precise legal route and consideration are unpublished. Inherited and Inherited and expanded were rejected because inheritance itself is not documented. Mixed was rejected because DMA's later co-founding is not independently shown to be material to his principal fortune. Unknown is no longer the least-specific supported value.

DRD's assets and customers are automotive, but its documented current business model is fleet and operational leasing, and S&P categorised it as a financial-services finance company. Finance & Investments is therefore used for the present primary industry while Automotive describes the original wealth-creation sector.

Strong official sources establish Samsun and 1963, but no authoritative source reviewed supplies an exact birth day or month. Those fields remain blank, as do unsupported middle-name and secondary-nationality fields.

Automotive distribution is the single supported approved tag because Derindere owned and chaired the group during its long Toyota-distribution period; it is marked former but defining. The active catalogue contains no accurate fleet-leasing or electric-mobility tag. Automotive dealerships is omitted to avoid overlap and because the reviewed evidence is stronger for distribution than for a defining personal dealership mandate.

The active DRD company website is exact-person verified through current official leadership pages and an independent company profile. No LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X or personal website result reviewed had a sufficiently strong exact-person bridge, so none is proposed.
